name: LiteParse + Tesseract
pipeline: PDFium/raster + bundled Tesseract, layout by grid projection

name: PaddleOCR PP-StructureV3
pipeline: layout detection → region OCR → table structure → reading order

name: GLM-OCR
pipeline: 0.9B VLM, 128K ctx — one page in, markdown out (vLLM or Zhipu API)

name: Chandra OCR 2
pipeline: datalab-to/chandra-ocr-2 — page in, markdown with layout and tables out (vLLM)

name: Unlimited-OCR
pipeline: tiled 640px "gundam" inference for long pages — page in, markdown out (vLLM)

name: Nemotron 3.5 Parse
pipeline: NVIDIA VLM document parser — page in, markdown/structured out (NIM or vLLM)
needs: NVIDIA NIM API key or GPU

name: PP-StructureV3 (GPU)
pipeline: PaddleOCR 3.7 server models: PP-DocLayout-L + PP-OCRv5_server + table/formula recognition
needs: Modal app ocr-playground-paddle; PaddleOCR 3.7 server models, per page

name: MinerU 2.5 (VLM)
pipeline: VLM backend: MinerU2.5-1.2B + layout/table models, all on GPU
needs: Modal app ocr-playground-mineru; MinerU 2.7.6, VLM backend
